nodes.label: Plan: unify pos Flutter app onto admin-panel-v2 Convex backend
nodes.rationale: kds_pos_backend was a throwaway sibling Convex project (single flat menu_items table, POS-only orders table, no device identity, hardcoded deployment URL, ad hoc string-keyed calls scattered per-feature); the decision was to retire it and have every flavour talk to the real, already-reviewed multi-tenant admin-panel-v2 backend instead, adding a first-class devices table + device-token auth independent of staff/customer accounts.

nodes.label: devices table schema (admin-panel-v2 addition)
nodes.rationale: Token itself (dv_<random>) is generated at registration time, returned once in the mutation response, and never persisted in plaintext - only its sha256 hash is stored, mirroring how a real API-key system and Better Auth session tokens are already handled.

nodes.label: lib/deviceAuthz.ts - deviceQuery/deviceMutation wrappers
nodes.rationale: Convex functions can't read custom headers the way an HTTP endpoint can, so the device token travels as an explicit first argument on every device-facing call, mirroring the existing customerAuthz.ts pattern for customerMutation/customerQuery.

nodes.label: orderPaymentEvents table (structured payment/refund event log)
nodes.rationale: Modeled as a structured event log rather than fields bolted onto orders, since a POS order can be refunded more than once - mirrors kds_pos_backend's existing Softpay transaction lifecycle (charge success/failure, refund with transaction snapshot, partial refunds).

nodes.label: Centralized Dart data-access layer (lib/Database)
nodes.rationale: Replaces ad hoc per-feature Convex code (Kiosk importing EmployeeTerminal's menu_service.dart/order_service.dart by relative path) with one shared client/model/repository layer so all flavours (including the not-yet-built HandHeldScreen) consume MenuRepository/OrderRepository instead of reaching into each other's feature folders.

nodes.label: Deferred: Practice (Ovning) / Proforma (Ej kvitto) receipts
nodes.rationale: Test cases 9-10 of Infrasec's TCS Certification Plan. Both raw TCS-D operations (agentExercise.ts/agentProfo.ts) already exist and work server-side, but nothing calls them except a standalone dev test script - no Flutter UI, no posPayments:reportEvent branch for either outcome. Not scheduled because sales has no current plan for a Test/Training mode; acceptable to certify without these two receipt types per the cert plan's own carve-out for uncertified functions.

nodes.label: Deferred: Refund fiscal retry
nodes.rationale: A refund's SoftPay money movement and its TCS-D fiscalization are two separate steps with no safe retry path if fiscalization comes back rejected/unconfirmed - replaying the same idempotencyKey just returns the old rejected result, and retrying without it risks a real second SoftPay refund. Stopgap (2026-08-17): orders_screen.dart detects the stuck case and disables the Refund button for that order for the rest of the session, with no backend field tracking it yet.

nodes.label: Changelog 2026-08-20: Receipt redesign, 5 missing SKVFS Ch.7 §1 fields
nodes.rationale: printer_service.dart's printReceipt() now prints address, sale date/time, register designation, means of payment, and manufacturing number of the control unit, matching reference receipt images; deliberately Flutter-only per explicit instruction to defer Convex changes, so registerAddress/registerDesignation/manufacturingNumber are hardcoded test-value placeholders rather than real per-restaurant/per-device config.

nodes.label: kds_pos_backend (retired Convex project)
nodes.rationale: Its menu_items/orders tables have no successor data (dev-only placeholder data) - nothing to migrate when retiring it in favor of admin-panel-v2.

nodes.label: admin-panel-v2 Convex backend (real multi-tenant backend)
nodes.rationale: organizations -> restaurants -> menuCategories/menuItems with images/stock/addons, orders/orderItems, and Better Auth for staff (RBAC) and restaurant customers; had no device/POS concept at all until this plan's additions, that domain having been explicitly deferred in its own CLAUDE.md.
